slides.text: Exam se ek raat pehle yeh mat karo
Naya chapter shuru mat karo. Ek raat mein naya kuch yaad nahi hota, bas ghabrahat badhti hai.
Pura syllabus dobara padhne ki koshish mat karo. Sirf formula, definitions aur short notes dekho.
Raat bhar jaagna galat plan hai. Neend memory ko pakka karti hai.
Kal ke liye sab kuch pehle se rakh lo: admit card, pen, ID, paani. Subah ki tension kam hogi.
Doston se "kitna ho gaya" poochna band karo. Doosron ki taiyari tumhari neend nahi hai.
Exam ke 10 minute pehle apne hi notes dekho. Naye doubts mat khodo.
Save karo. Exam se pehle wali raat yeh dobara padhna.
slides.sub: Follow for one study rule a day

caption:
Exam se pehle ki raat ka plan chhota rakho: revise, so jao, aur shaant raho.

Kal kaunsa exam hai? Comment mein batao, all the best!
